shortDescription: Thailand received investment applications worth 1.7 trillion baht ($50.37 billion) in the first nine months of this year, up 28% from the same period in 2025, its investment board said on Monday.Growth was driven mainly by the electronics, digital and food industries, the Board of Investment said…

children: Thailand received investment applications worth 1.7 trillion baht ($50.37 billion) in the first nine months of this year, up 28% from the same period in 2025, its investment board said on Monday.
Growth was driven mainly by the electronics, digital and food industries, the Board of Investment said.
